crossRefs.note: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?
Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?
Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;
while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.
I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to…
This is what Yahweh, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies, says: “I am the first, and I am the last…
For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with…
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me that is to be…
Aren’t you from everlasting, Yahweh my God, my Holy One? We will not die. Yahweh, you have appointed him for judgment.…
which in its own times he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings, and Lord of lords.
He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen, nor can see: to whom be honor and…
And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
“I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”
“Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.

translations.web: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
translations.bsb: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.
translations.kjv: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
translations.asv: Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
